test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Nov, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Identify the error in the usage of the future tense in the given sentence and choose the correct sentence from the following options.

Parvati finish the painting in one hour.

options.text: Parvati has been finishing the painting in one hour.
Parvati was finished the painting in one hour.
Parvati will finish the painting in one hour.
Parvati had been finishing the painting in one hour.

solution:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. Parvati will finish the painting in one hour.
